given: a location has no stock records
when: the warehouse team member views that location on the home screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" state is shown instead of a blank page

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover the populated table (rows present, quantities aligned); AC3 covers the disjoint empty case where there are no records, asserting an explicit "No stock at this location" message rather than a blank page. The empty-state message can be absent (blank page) while populated rows render and align fine, and vice versa, so it fails independently.
